scene.summary: Coils of mended fishing net hang from the rafters of a timber loft. Nessa, a net-mender in a tarred apron, is splicing a rope.
visible_facts: Coils of mended fishing net hang from the rafters.
Nessa is splicing a rope at a low bench.

topics.text: Nessa splices rope and mends nets for the fishing boats.
